what: corrections made after the registration was written to the ledger; the registration file itself is not changed (the driver refuses a registration that differs from the recorded one)

corrections.when_in_the_run: after round 1 was complete and after the five searches of round 2; after the unlock of adoption:2; before any run on an environment of adoption:2 was recorded
corrections.event: the registered run stopped with an error in the gate of round 2, the first time the learner was run on the adoption set of that round (twelve runs, six on knapsack and six on regression, had been handed to four worker processes; no record of any of them was written): problems of knapsack had 1 + m attribute columns with m = 5, 10 or 30, and the learner builds one parameter vector per environment. The environment regression had the same defect (laws with one to eight input variables).
what: rsi6/environments/knapsack.py: every problem is presented with one profit column and as many constraint columns as the largest number of constraints of the benchmark's problems (30); absent constraints are zero columns (exact: a constraint whose coefficients are all zero binds nothing)

rsi6/environments/regression.py: every law is presented with as many input columns as the law with the most variables has (8); absent variables are zero columns (exact: the law does not depend on them)
rsi6/kernel/run.py: layout() and a check that refuses an environment whose training or fresh problems differ in generic layout; all problems of a run are checked before the learner is called

rsi6/tests/test_kernel.py: four tests (one layout and one descriptor list for every instance of every environment; the layout covers whether an option can be taken more than once; the kernel refuses a fixture with different layouts; zero columns are exact and are learned from at the registered budget, on made-up numbers)
corrections.not_changed: the learner (rsi6/learner/learner.py, rsi6/learner/version.py) and rsi6/kernel/problem.py have the hashes of the last correction recorded in freeze_L0.json; no registered number, seed, budget or rule changed
alternatives_not_taken: hiding the constraint coefficients (only the profit column): takes published instance data away from the learner
keeping one class of problems only: discards two thirds of the benchmark after the fact
changing the learner so that it accepts problems of different layouts: a change of the frozen learner that the contract does not need
corrections.scores_seen_before_the_choice: none: no run of the learner on knapsack or regression existed, in the registered ledger or in development

independent_audit.reports: rsi6/audit/layout_correction_20261112/ (the diff as audited, and the auditors' reports)

auditor_a.scope: exactness and information of the two adapters, completeness of the layout check, the written record
auditor_a.findings: 1 major, 3 minor, 6 notes; no blocking finding
auditor_a.established: with its own parsers and evaluators: all 180 knapsack problems and all 118 laws are presented exactly; nothing but the published instance is exposed; one layout per environment over 3,196 problems; 38 recorded runs repeat identically under the corrected kernel; the ledger chain is intact and holds no run on knapsack or regression

after_the_audit: major finding fixed: layout() now also records whether an option can be taken more than once, and the test compares the learner's descriptor names

minor findings fixed: the test of zero columns now runs at the registered budget and asserts that learning rounds happened; 'one to eight' input variables; fresh problems are checked before the learner is called
after these fixes: 26 of 26 tests pass, and 15 recorded runs (5 environments, 5 versions; search, gate and confirmation runs) repeat identically with the final code

auditor_b.scope: no recorded result changed, degrees of freedom of the choice, the written record
auditor_b.verdict: none: the agent was stopped by the usage limit of the session before it reported
auditor_b.what_its_working_files_show: it had repeated, with the corrected code, all 1,192 runs that were in the ledger before the correction (1,228 repetitions in four passes); every one was identical to its ledger record in all 23 compared fields, among them the scores, the fresh instances, the units, the learner's report and the digest of the capability
auditor_b.files: rsi6/audit/layout_correction_20261112/auditor_b_working_files/ (its scripts and outputs; the logs of the repetitions reduced to the record index and the comparison), and auditor_b_partial_summary.json, a count made by the orchestrating session from those logs
auditor_b.not_done: its checks of the degrees of freedom and of the wording of this record were not reported

independent_audit.machine_note: the gate and confirmation runs of round 2 were measured while the second auditor's two processes were repeating recorded runs on the same four-core machine; scores do not depend on load, measured CPU-seconds may

limits_of_the_correction: the zero columns are exact for the problem; for the learner they are inert under the descriptor scales minmax and z, and not under the scale rank, which turns a constant column into a ramp over the index (generation 0 and every nominee recorded so far use minmax)

found by the audit, not caused by the correction, and not changed (the learner is frozen): the learner's test for a constant target is absolute (standard deviation below 1e-12). Five of the 24 fresh laws of regression have observed targets below it (one in the deciding half, four in the confirming half; none of the 16 training laws); on such a law a fitted predictor answers at the wrong magnitude and scores 0, while the untrained answer is unaffected. The regression numbers of round 2 have to be read with this.
one law of regression (medium, iii.17.37) has its value equal to its first input in almost every row; it is in neither the training nor the fresh set of the registered split
